decisions.title: ADR describes the lab as a production footprint
decisions.note: Edit: scoped to a training/demo platform with no production data and best-effort availability.

decisions.title: The no-zone decision does not preserve automatic redundancy exceptions
decisions.note: Edit: decision limited to the web app and SQL MI; ACR Premium and Service Bus Premium keep their automatic zone redundancy.

decisions.title: Recovery is attributed to platform governance instead of IaC redeployment
decisions.note: Edit: recovery is best-effort and owner-initiated redeployment from IaC; no automatic failover or DR replication.

decisions.title: The ADR claims an approved cost envelope without a fixed cap
decisions.note: Edit: cites about $1.81/hour against the brief's soft ~$1.83/hour; states there is no fixed monthly cap.

decisions.title: The Context block presents a stitched paraphrase as a verbatim quote
decisions.note: Edit: replaced with the assessment's verbatim sentence, with the requirements and region-row text cited separately.
